description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Enum, which provides validation for enumeration attributes by checking if a given string value is within a predefined list of valid values. It includes methods for constructing the enum, validating input strings, and creating enum instances with specific case sensitivity options.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_Enum
classes.description: A class for validating attribute values against a list of enumerated valid values, with optional case sensitivity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the enum with a list of valid values and an optional case sensitivity flag.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if a given string value is valid according to the enum, considering case sensitivity, and returns the cleaned value or false.

methods.name: make
methods.description: Creates a new enum instance from a comma-separated list of values, optionally case sensitive.
